parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hi there, I heard about the Upper Province Folk Festival and I'm interested in attending. When is it happening this year?

This year's Upper Province Folk Festival will be held on a weekend in June. Traditionally, it has always been held in May.

That's great to know. I'm planning to bring my kids along. One is 14 years old and the other is 13 years old.

I'm sorry, but they need to purchase tickets. Only children aged 12 or younger can participate in this event for free.

Wonderful. Where exactly is the festival taking place?

The festival will be held at Donalson Farm. The owner, who is a music lover, has graciously sponsored this event. I'll spell the name for you to help you locate it. D-O-N-A-L-S-O-N.

That sounds like a perfect location. How can I purchase tickets for the festival?

To participate in the event, you will need to purchase a combined ticket that allows you access to all activities. Buying single tickets for each activity separately can result in significant fees when accumulated.

I see. What is the schedule for the festival? When should I arrive?

The festival is scheduled to start on Saturday. But the camping service is provided on a first-come, first-served basis. It is recommended to arrive on Thursday to secure your camping spot.

Good to know. Is there anything else I should be aware of while camping?

It is strongly recommended to bring a light with you as it can get very dark at night and it's important to ensure the safety of your children.

Thank you for the advice. Are there any special activities for children?

Yes, we have a wide range of options for children, including campfire singing and nature walks. One of the highlights is the opportunity for children to attend a concert on the last night, where they can even perform music with professional musicians. So you can bring your musical instruments if you want.

That's good to know. What are some essential items we should bring?

Some essential items to bring include sunscreen. Camping often involves a significant amount of time outdoors exposed to the sun's rays. It is important to protect your skin.

That sounds like a lot of fun. What if someone gets injured or feels unwell during the festival?

The emergency station in the camp can handle minor injuries, mosquito bites and headaches. However, participants should bring their own medicine if they have allergies or asthma.

Is there a medical professional available on site?

Yes, there will be a nurse available at all times. You can consult her if your children feel uncomfortable or have ailments. Additionally, the camping area has hired a doctor as a consultant who will be located in the nearby town. The doctor will be present in the camp only when there is a need to address complicated medical conditions.

Thank you so much for answering all my questions.

You're welcome. If you have any more questions or need further assistance, feel free to reach out. We're here to help. Enjoy the festival.

analyses.content: 组织者明确说明今年的音乐节将在 June（六月）的一个周末举行。
This year's Upper Province Folk Festival will be held on a weekend in June. Traditionally, it has always been held in May.
不要听到 "May" 就填，那是“传统上”（Traditionally）举办的时间，不是今年的时间。
I'm sorry, but they need to purchase tickets. Only children aged 12 or younger can participate in this event for free.
不要被咨询者的孩子年龄（14岁和13岁）干扰，他们是需要买票的。
组织者指出只有 12 岁或更小的孩子可以免费参加。
The festival will be held at Donalson Farm... I'll spell the name for you to help you locate it. D-O-N-A-L-S-O-N.
注意拼写，中间只有一个 'n' 和一个 'l'，严格按照 D-O-N-A-L-S-O-N 记录。
农场的名字 Donalson 被逐个字母拼写了出来，直接记录即可。
To participate in the event, you will need to purchase a combined ticket that allows you access to all activities.
不要填 "single"，录音说买单张票会导致高额费用，是反面例子。
为了参加所有活动，你需要购买一张 combined（组合/套票）ticket。
The festival is scheduled to start on Saturday. ... It is recommended to arrive on Thursday to secure your camping spot.
不要听到 "Saturday" 就填，那是节日开始的时间，不是为了抢占露营位建议到达的时间。
虽然节日周六开始，但为了确保（secure）露营位，建议在 Thursday（周四）到达。
因为晚上很黑，强烈建议带一个 light（灯/光源）。
It is strongly recommended to bring a light with you as it can get very dark at night...
所听即所得，不要自己替换成 "torch" 或 "lamp"，除非你有十足把握，否则优先填原文词汇。
One of the highlights is the opportunity for children to attend a concert on the last night, where they can even perform music...
题目是 "instruments for a ..."，这里填场合名词 concert，不要填 instruments（乐器）本身。
孩子们有机会参加最后一晚的 concert（音乐会），甚至可以带着乐器和专业音乐家一起演奏。
Some essential items to bring include sunscreen. Camping often involves a significant amount of time outdoors...
注意这是一个合成词，不要分开写，也不要拼错。
因为露营涉及大量户外时间，需要带的必备品包括 sunscreen（防晒霜）。
The emergency station in the camp can handle minor injuries, mosquito bites and headaches.
注意录音中用的是复数形式，填写时也要保持一致。
急救站可以处理轻微伤害、蚊虫叮咬以及 headaches（头痛）。
Yes, there will be a nurse available at all times. You can consult her if your children feel uncomfortable or have ailments.
不要填 "doctor"，医生只在处理复杂情况时才出现，而且是住在附近的镇上。
如果孩子感到不适，可以随时咨询现场的 nurse（护士）。
